You will need:

  • Ten pieces of treasure - you could use toys, coins, or pieces of pasta
  • A bowl or other container to cover some of the treasure
  • Optional: write numbers 1-10 on separate pieces of paper (you can use the dice below if you prefer)

text: A bowl about to cover up ten counters.

editorState:
How to play:

  1. Choose a number (or roll the dice below to get a number).
  2. Ask your child to find that number of pieces of treasure.
  3. Ask your child to shut their eyes.
  4. Bury some of the treasure under the container.
  5. Can they look at the number and the unburied treasure to work out how many pieces of treasure you buried? 
  6. Swap roles and play again!
